mapper.select: SELECT bbs31_content_id AS content_id , bbs31_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , bbs31_person_id AS person_id , bbs31_title AS title , CASE WHEN COALESCE(bbs31_hide_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN bbs31_title ELSE '<'||'b'||'>(비공개) '||'<'||'/b'||'>'||bbs31_title END AS title_role , NULL AS content , (COALESCE(bbs31_hide_yn,'false') = 'true') AS hide_yn , ( TO_CHAR(bbs31_reg_date, 'YY.MM.DD') ||' '|| bbs31_time ) AS reg_date_str , f_emp_kor_nm(bbs31_person_id) AS person_name FROM bbs31_content WHERE 1=1 AND bbs31_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND CONCAT(bbs31_title, f_emp_kor_nm(bbs31_person_id)) ILIKE #{searchText} AND ( (COALESCE(bbs31_hide_yn,'false') = 'false') OR (COALESCE(bbs31_hide_yn,'false') = 'true' AND bbs31_person_id = #{personId}) ) ORDER BY bbs31_reg_date DESC, bbs31_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT bbs31_content_id AS content_id , bbs31_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , bbs31_person_id AS person_id , bbs31_title AS title , CASE WHEN COALESCE(bbs31_hide_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN bbs31_title ELSE '<'||'b'||'>(비공개) '||'<'||'/b'||'>'||bbs31_title END AS title_role , bbs31_content AS content , (COALESCE(bbs31_hide_yn,'false') = 'true') AS hide_yn , ( TO_CHAR(bbs31_reg_date, 'YY.MM.DD') ||' '|| bbs31_time ) AS reg_date_str , f_emp_kor_nm(bbs31_person_id) AS person_name FROM bbs31_content WHERE bbs31_content_id = #{contentId} AND bbs31_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs31_content (bbs31_content_id, bbs31_company_id, bbs31_class_tree_id, bbs31_person_id, bbs31_title, bbs31_content, bbs31_hide_yn, bbs31_reg_date, bbs31_time) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{companyId}, #{classTreeId}, #{personId}, #{title}, #{content}, CASE WHEN #{hideYn} THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END, f_sysdate(), TO_CHAR(f_sysdate(), 'HH24:MI:SS'))
